title: Set Up Your Mac
summary: Install and understand the toolchain the whole hub uses: a container runtime (Docker Desktop, OrbStack or Colima), the Kubernetes and Terraform CLIs, image tooling, editor extensions and shell ergonomics — plus how the Linux VM behind Docker on macOS actually works.
objectives: Choose between Docker Desktop, OrbStack and Colima based on licensing, resources and features
Explain why Docker on macOS runs inside a Linux VM and what that means for bind mounts, networking and amd64 images
Install and verify kubectl, kind, helm, k9s, terraform, jq, yq, dive, trivy and hadolint with Homebrew
Switch between Docker endpoints with docker context and repair a broken socket or context
Size the VM's CPU, memory and disk and set up shell completion and aliases
